from flask import Flask
import flask_tasks
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask_login import LoginManager
from .config import config
from .models import db, login_manager

def configure_app(app):
    db.init_app(app)
    login_manager.init_app(app)

def register_routes(app):
    from . import views
    app.register_blueprint(views.bp)

def create_app(config_name='default'):
    """Create Flask application and register components."""
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.from_object(config[config_name])
    config[config_name].init_app(app)

    configure_app(app)
    register_routes(app)

    return app

app = create_app()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()

output:
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from flask import Flask, request
import flask_tasks

app = Flask(__name__)
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class User(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'users'
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    username = db.Column(db.String(64), index=True)

@app.route('/')
def hello():
    username = request.args.get('username', '')
    safe_user = User.query.filter_by(username=username).first()
    return "Hello, %s" % safe_user.username

from flask import Flask
import flask_tasks
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy
from .auth import auth
from .main import main

application = Flask(__name__)
application.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:////tmp/test.db'
application.config['SECRET_KEY'] = 'super-secret-key'
application.config['GOOGLE_CONSUMER_KEY'] = 'your-google-consumer-key'
application.config['GOOGLE_CONSUMER_SECRET'] = 'your-google-consumer-secret'
application.config['FACEBOOK_APP_ID'] = 'your-facebook-app-id'
application.config['FACEBOOK_APP_SECRET'] = 'your-facebook-app-secret'

database = SQLAlchemy(application)

# Register blueprints in a different order
application.register_blueprint(main)
application.register_blueprint(auth)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    database.create_all()
    application.run(debug=True)
